svg.title: 365 Data Science AI Agent Engineer Track: 15-Day Free Access Triage and Decision Flow
svg.desc: Editorial study-triage schematic based on public 365 Data Science course outlines. Videos were not viewed. Project 01, 02, and 03 labels report the promotional infographic, not verified video demonstrations or learning outcomes. Study priorities and practice goals are recommendations, not measured results.

g.text: Curriculum Path & Decision Triage: 15-Day Free Access vs. Production Reality
Public outlines only; videos not viewed. Infographic project labels do not verify course delivery. Triage is editorial advice.
every single day with zero study breaks.
Are you building production agentic systems,
or reviewing general introductory data science?
▶ Path B: Fast-track Tier 2 apps (2x speed)
▶ Path C: Prioritize Tier 1 MCP & LangGraph
Focus strictly on Tier 1 (8h video / 15h total).
TIER 3 · LOW LEVERAGE FOR WORKING ENGINEERS (SKIP)
Symbolic AI vs Connectionist, ML/DL taxonomy. High-level survey.
Course 2: Intro to AI Agents & Agentic AI
Sensors, actuators, reflex vs goal-based agents. Conceptual taxonomy.
Algorithmic fairness, governance, EU AI Act compliance.
Conway's Game of Life (15h), User Classif. (10h), PCA Music (3h).
TRIAGE: DEFER FOR THIS STUDY GOAL
Workflows, prompt structuring, ReAct, Tree of Thought patterns.
• Public topics: chains, prompts, and RAG
UI integration, OpenAI chat completions, mock interview app.
Separately Listed Practice Card · 8 Hours Estimated
Vector store indexing, document retrieval, and conversational chain.
TRIAGE: HIGH-VALUE PRACTICE IF TIME ALLOWS
• Public topics: MCP concepts and outline design
KEY VALUE: TOOL TRANSPORT & AGENT CAPABILITY
• Syllabus project: AI Prompt Chaining & Task Routing
• Public topics: agent tools and workflow patterns
KEY VALUE: REWOO DECOUPLED AGENT PIPELINES
• Public topics: retriever and generator evaluation
• Faithfulness, human feedback, bias and safety
ALWAYS ACCESSIBLE · NO TIMERS OR PAYWALLS
• Standard Free Tier: Course previews only,
• Verify MCP tool permissions and isolation
• Test SQLite state recovery across restarts
• Measure RAG quality and judge variance
API COSTS AND RESULTS NOT MEASURED
Outline audit · Nov 2026 · Not video verification
Promotional labels only: Project 01: Q&A Chatbot with LangChain · Project 02: Prompt Chaining & Task Routing · Project 03: Crypto Analysis Agent. Not a verified module inventory.
